Surviving: falsification is already the spine (claims run against grounds, struck-and-replaced when contradicted, typed when unchecked) but assert-then-research-disprove is refuted — the mouth never researches, open-world absence refutes nothing, an adversarial query feeds the poisoned snippet-adoption that can strike a TRUE claim. What it should be: ground-first preflight, refuse-or-type the ungrounded guess, empty result is a typed gap never a license; the actionable gaps are checking what the proxy does not (witness rung, claim ledger, veto, contests unwired) and fixing snippet-adoption, not adding a disproof search.

discrete-multi-unit-coding.signal: an NL ask to WRITE a file/module/script/library that names or lists more than one function/unit (a discrete coding task, not a question)
discrete-multi-unit-coding.read: treat it as a BUILD, not a turn: detect the shape from plain language; decompose into the INDEPENDENT units (the named functions); compute the structure (decomposition, assembly, validation) mechanically; draw ONLY the unit bodies from the model, CONCURRENTLY (bounded by parallelism); extract EXACTLY the named unit from each draw (split on definition boundaries — a draw often emits every function it saw, which duplicates the file if the whole reply is kept); assemble and validate — a real testCommand gates; else the hard validator gates (validatePython: pyodide compile+AST undefined-name scan+exec; validateHtml: structure), and only a language with no validator falls to a syntax parse, disclosed as UNVERIFIED. The gate is the strongest the language allows, never weaker than compile+run. The structure is computed, only the units are generated, and the test decides. FLOOR vs MEANING (measured): the hard validator passes the MODULE (compile+ast+exec of the definitions, plus a smoke), NOT the code behavior — a module whose function raises on CALL passes the validator cleanly (normalize returns a list; parse_line calls .split on it -> AttributeError on call; validator ok:true, zero findings). So compile+exec is the structural FLOOR; only a testCommand that actually CALLS the code decides meaning.
discrete-multi-unit-coding.falsifying: a discrete build whose units DEPEND on each other text (so concurrent assembly is incoherent) — then it is a chain, not a fan, and this path is wrong; or a build whose assembled file fails its own test while a single draw passed, which concedes decomposition lost something
discrete-multi-unit-coding.basis: session 2026-09-21: native/organs/code-build.js, POST /v1/build, the /v1/ask build-detection hook; the duplicate-defs bug (kept the whole reply) fixed by extracting the named unit; measured: 5 units, ~750-960 tokens, 9-27s, syntax-verified from a plain NL prompt

kleeneup-regex-eviction.signal: a regex used to FIND or SNIP (a .test()/.match()/.exec() gate, a verbatim quote cut, a work detection), or a request to replace regex with the physics system
kleeneup-regex-eviction.read: swarm it against native/kernel/kleene-up.js (Handle: Kleene): a thing is found by its byte address in the field (needle + anchor + window, sha256-verified ground), never by a pattern; a snip is cut at a permanent address, never by a match; reduceRegex names each pattern literal (one needle) / semantic (a word class = needle set over the tokenized field) / structural (parses or sanitizes — grammar, not finding, disclosed and kept) / typed_gap (backrefs/lookaround/dynamic — a named gap); absence is a result, never a guess. The sweep is a measurement: scripts/kleene-up.mjs surveys and names; the migration is per-file work (verbatim-snip.js is the worked example).
kleeneup-regex-eviction.falsifying: a migratable literal/semantic pattern that a needle set cannot reproduce over the real field (a needle that misses a span the regex matched), or a claimed migration that leaves a structural pattern silently converted, breaks the map
kleeneup-regex-eviction.basis: archon build 2026-09-21: kernel engine + organ (mozi three-tests ground), verbatim-snip conversion, survey 1786 occurrences (749 migratable / 1008 structural / 29 typed gaps)
